## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, what happens today, and what happens with this change. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Mark unavailable checks as not run and explain why. For display/input changes, include remote resolution, local window/viewport size, display backing scale, viewing modes, and corner/coordinate checks from `docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md`. Add redacted before/after screenshots when useful.

## Documentation and limitations

Note changed controls, updated docs/changelog entries, known limitations, or remaining risks. Identify vendor changes and any added dependency/license notices. Do not include passwords, private connection details, or personal desktop content.
